title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Terms: Tenure Relief on the Tow Notice Fee
content:
**Term.** A tenure relief is taken off the tow notice fee on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement:

(1) **$6.00** for a tenant who has held the agreement at least 24 months and made at least 8 payments on it in the last 12 months;

(2) **$3.00** for a tenant who has held it at least 12 months but fewer than 24 months and made at least 4 payments on it in that time;

(3) nothing for every other tenant.

The relief is taken off the fee after the fee level has been multiplied by anything it is multiplied by; the fee is never below zero, and it is rounded to the cent.

**Definitions.** Months held are whole calendar months from the start date to the handling date, counted to the same day of the later month. Payments are the payment entries on the agreement's ledger in the window. A window of the last 12 months covers entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month.

| Months held | Payments in last 12 months | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more | 8 or more | $6.00 |
| 24 or more | 7 or fewer | nothing |
| 12 to 23 | 4 or more | $3.00 |
| 12 to 23 | 3 or fewer | nothing |
| under 12 | any | nothing |

Hypothetical example: a tenant at exactly 24 months with exactly 8 payments has $6.00 taken off a fee of $62.50, leaving $56.50.
